Hi Priyom,

We just completed the self-serve signup and are evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a production rollout. Our workload is fairly bursty: typical steady traffic ~5k reqs/min, but we have peaks up to ~80k reqs/min for short windows. Latency SLO is 200ms p50 / 500ms p95.

Can we schedule a deep-dive demo that covers Dedicated capacity sizing, autoscale/burst behavior and how routing/fallbacks work across regions? We're split between engineering in SF (PST) and ops in Lisbon (WET), so afternoon PST or late morning UTC would be best.

Thanks,
Elena
